Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Role Overview:
For one of our clients in the Utilities industry, we are looking for an experienced SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Developer with Power BI to join an international project. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions, working closely with business stakeholders to deliver high-quality insights and data-driven solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, enhance, and maintain reporting solutions using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
Design and build interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations in Power BI.
Create, optimize, and maintain data models to support business intelligence and reporting requirements.
Analyze business needs and translate functional requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
Integrate and work with Microsoft Dynamics as the primary data source for analytics and reporting.
Collaborate with business users and technical teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
Produce and maintain technical and functional documentation.
Support testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of reporting solutions.
 Required Skills & Experience:
Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) development.
Strong expertise in Power BI development, including dashboard and report creation.
Experience with data modeling and data preparation for reporting purposes.
Ability to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics data is considered a strong advantage.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Professional proficiency in English.
